verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs describe API-driven payment operations: direct charges, authorization and capture, refunds and voids, recurring charges, and a 100% API 3DS integration, all marketed as many payment methods through one API. The evidence is mostly page titles, though, and no machine-readable API spec was found (all OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404), so the depth and completeness of the public API reference is unproven. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference spec, endpoint-level reference detail in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
